name: Urbancore
summary: Urbancore is an aesthetic based on imagery of urban cities and street life.
description: Urbancore is an aesthetic based on imagery of urban cities and street life. Urbancore is associated to real-life, modern-day society and almost always is based in recent decades. As it is a really broad aesthetic, it can revolve around city streets and architecture, graffiti, skate parks at night, urban fashion and picnics. Similar to High School Dream , this aesthetic embodies a youthful and somewhat rebellious spirit of a teen living in a nostalgic time.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Materialism, expensive clothes (although you don't have to be materialistic to achieve this aesthetic), urban life

visualDNA.colour: neutrals - gray, black, beige; sometimes contrasted with bright paint colors, otherwise any colors, depending on the style
